seo.title: Active Navigation in Conversational Environments — your brand in the AI's answer | Advia
seo.description: We measure how your brand shows up in the models' answers, understand where they get them from and create the content the AI cites.

hero.eyebrow: We turn your brand into the answer
hero.titular: AI has changed how your consumers <key>decide</key>. You have to change how you talk to them
hero.lede: Conversational environments let your consumers decide quickly and precisely. Vera understands how they do it, so that there too you are the answer.

respuesta.pregunta: Which hybrid SUV should I buy for commuting and weekend trips?
respuesta.antes: For that use, the most recommended option is
respuesta.despues: followed by Toyota and Kia, in the same segment. All three cover what you are looking for and share restrained fuel consumption…

pregunta.titularDespues: are you the answer the AI mentions?
pregunta.lede: More and more decisions are settled in a conversation with an AI, without going through a search engine. Being in that answer is what we call Intentional Visibility: being present at the moment someone wants to solve something and hasn't yet decided how.
pregunta.citaFuente: Blog · Introduction to Active Navigation, III
pregunta.cita: “Millions of new, hyper-informed prescribers… and you can't call them to ask them to correct their message.”

medir.titular: Before moving anything, we measure <key>where you stand</key>
medir.lede: An analysis of the real conversations in your category, not of a list of prompts. It is the first thing you see, and the baseline everything that follows is measured against.

medidas.pregunta: In how many answers in your category do you appear?
medidas.desc: We count how many answers the AI mentions you in, and in what position.

medidas.pregunta: What does it say about you when it mentions you?
medidas.desc: By decision factor: price, range, service. What the AI believes about your brand is not always what you tell.

medidas.pregunta: Where does it get the answer from?
medidas.desc: The domains and URLs the model consults to answer. That is where the work happens next.
The same measures for your competitors, and how they move from one measurement to the next.

estanterias.titular: Only a small fraction of the sources the AI cites come from your website. You need all <key>five shelves</key>
estanterias.lede: Editorial, social, owned, multimedia and authoritative content. Your own carries the least weight, and it is precisely the only one most brands work on.
estanterias.nota: Illustrative proportion. The actual split of cited sources is measured per category and awaits real data.

ciclo.lede: Publishing changes what the models read, so the next measurement comes out different. The difference between one cycle and the next is the result: there is nothing to take on faith.

pasos.texto: Where you stand today in your category's answers, and which sources they come from.
Which sources are giving your competitors their citations and what kind of content the AI cites. That yields the editorial plan: your website and the publishers.
We publish that content through our publisher network and on your channels. And we measure again.

paid.titular: While organic presence is being built, we complement it with <key>paid media in ChatGPT</key>
paid.lede: The same simulation that measures your visibility tells when you will be a relevant answer. That is what the activation is built on.

items.desc: The simulations tell us where you will be relevant to your consumer, beyond classic keywords.
Different messages for different needs: the ad responds to what the consumer has in front of them.
During the campaign we see which messages work best and shift the weight towards them.

cierre.titular: Request an analysis of your <key>AI visibility</key>
cierre.lede: We show you how often you appear today in your category's answers, against whom and on which factors.
